classes.name: Sepulchral Sovereign
resource_rules: Eligible corpse denial, cleansing, or controlled harvesting can generate corpse charge through authored adapters.
All Grave Architecture structures share the same class resource and encounter spawn cap.
Boss and event corpses may use authored values rather than ordinary corpse-charge values.

classes.name: Beast-Crown
resource_rules: Crown Bond represents active command bandwidth, not a damage meter.
Elite taming challenges temporarily reserve one Crown Bond slot while unresolved.
Protected bosses and explicitly excluded mythic creatures cannot consume or bypass Crown Bond rules.
